caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur with an engraved pattern, attached to a brown leather strap or spur cover. The spur is rendered in shades of silver and grey with detailed, ornate designs etched along its body. The rowel, or the rotating wheel part of the spur, is black and features eight pointed tips. The attached leather piece is a medium brown color, stitched with a slightly darker thread, and has a rounded, padded shape with a circular opening and additional stitching patterns visible on its surface. The background of the image is a plain, off-white or light beige color. The artist's name, "ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE," is written in small, grey block letters to the right of the objects.
title: Spur and Rowel
